# Compression

Compress responses with zstd, Brotli or gzip, chosen per client. Text such as HTML, JSON, CSS and JavaScript shrinks to 10–30% of its size.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `compress` |
| **Category** | Traffic |
| **Requires** | Goma Gateway 1.2.0 or newer |

:::warning Gateway version
A route using this middleware fails to load on a gateway older than **1.2.0**. Miabi does not read the running gateway's version, so nothing stops you saving it — the route is what reports the problem.
:::

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `algorithms` | list of text | no | — | Codings offered, in order of preference: zstd, br, gzip. Empty offers all three. Example: `zstd`. |
| `minSize` | text | no | — | Smaller bodies are sent uncompressed. Bytes (1024) or a size such as 1KiB. Example: `1KiB`. |
| `levels` | group | no | — | Levels. |
| `excludedPaths` | list of text | no | — | Never compressed. Exclude pages that show user input next to a secret such as a CSRF token (BREACH). Example: `/account/*`. |
| `excludedContentTypes` | list of text | no | — | Excluded content types. Example: `application/pdf`. |
| `includedContentTypes` | list of text | no | — | Replaces the built-in list of text types. Empty keeps the built-in list. Example: `text/*`. |
| `upstream` | one of `passthrough`, `identity` | no | `passthrough` | passthrough keeps a body the app already compressed. identity asks the app for an uncompressed body, so the gateway does all the compressing. |

### `levels`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gzip` | number | no | — | 1 (fastest) to 9 (smallest). Example: `5`. |
| `br` | number | no | — | 1 to 11. Above 4 costs a lot of gateway CPU for little gain. Example: `2`. |
| `zstd` | one of `fastest`, `default`, `better`, `best` | no | — | zstd. |
